real_environment: a bright 1904 St. Petersburg physiology laboratory with tall windows
scale_anchor_object: wooden harness stand on the laboratory table

cast.subject: porcelain dog in a brown leather harness

wardrobe.physiologist: white laboratory coat and full white beard
wardrobe.assistant: white laboratory coat and dark trousers
wardrobe.dog: brown leather harness straps suspended from an overhead wooden crossbar

must_have_scenes.title: The sound alone: drops fall with no food
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: A harnessed dog drooling into a glass tube at the sound of a ticking metronome, with no food in sight - 'Pavlov's dog'.

key_visual.description: the harnessed porcelain dog hears the ticking metronome before any food appears and saliva drips from the cheek tube into the graduated glass vial

must_have_scenes.title: Fitting the dog: cheek funnel, tube and graduated glass
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: The glass tube sticking out of the dog's cheek.

must_have_scenes.title: Pairing: the tick, then the food
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: Sound first, food second - the pairing everyone learns in school.

must_have_scenes.title: The experimenter is the noise
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: The scientist himself spoils the experiment.

must_have_scenes.title: Timing test: buzzer after food vs before food
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: Same sound, opposite result - only the order changed.

must_have_scenes.title: The soundproof laboratory: dog alone, experimenter behind the wall
must_have_scenes.recognition_hook: Walls between dog and scientist - and the sound still works.

setup.camera: Wide establishing shot in a bright Saint Petersburg laboratory with tall windows, camera smoothly tracks forward toward the wooden harness stand
setup.action: A matte-white porcelain dog stands in brown leather straps inside a wooden frame while a white-coated assistant mannequin flicks a brass metronome and scribbles notes
setup.prop_change: The metronome pendulum swings and ticks while clear saliva beads at a glass cheek funnel and drips into a graduated glass tube
setup.reaction: A bearded physiologist mannequin in a white coat grips the stand and leans in as liquid rises in the tube with no food bowl present

symptom.camera: Close-up side profile on the porcelain dog in the wooden harness stand with the ticking brass metronome behind it, camera pushes in on the cheek tube
symptom.action: The matte-white porcelain dog pricks its ears at the metronome, licks its muzzle, and salivates as the white-coated assistant mannequin taps the glass tube
symptom.prop_change: The brass pendulum swings while clear drops drip from the glass cheek funnel down a thin tube and splash inside the etched cylinder
symptom.reaction: The assistant mannequin freezes mid-tally with lifted shoulders and leans closer to the scale marks in bright daylight

failure.camera: Medium lateral tracking shot across the sunlit laboratory from the seated experimenter mannequin to the porcelain dog on the wooden harness stand
failure.action: A white-coated experimenter mannequin on a wooden chair shifts posture, coughs, and slams his notebook shut as the porcelain dog jerks its head and paces in the harness
failure.prop_change: The leather straps sway, the notebook slams shut on his knee, and clear liquid drips early into the graduated glass tube before any signal starts
failure.reaction: The experimenter mannequin slumps on the chair and rubs his forehead with dropped shoulders in bright daylight

crisis.camera: Medium over-the-shoulder shot past the white-coated assistant mannequin toward the porcelain dog on the wooden stand and a wall-mounted electric bell box
crisis.action: The assistant mannequin pulls back an empty enamel food bowl first and only then presses the wall button, while the porcelain dog sniffs the empty stand
crisis.prop_change: The metal hammer on the wall box vibrates and buzzes after the meal is over, while the graduated glass tube beside the dog's cheek stays dry
crisis.reaction: The assistant mannequin taps the empty glass tube twice and shakes his head with slumped shoulders in bright laboratory daylight

pivot.camera: Medium tracking shot across the wooden stand from the ticking pyramid metronome on the shelf to the porcelain dog in its leather harness
pivot.action: The white-coated assistant mannequin flicks the brass metronome pendulum first, then swings an enamel food bowl under the porcelain dog's muzzle as the dog lunges and eats
pivot.prop_change: The metronome ticks steadily, food crumbs scatter across the sliding bowl, and clear saliva drips rapidly down the cheek funnel into the glass tube
pivot.reaction: The bearded physiologist mannequin braces both hands on the stand as the assistant pulls the bowl back and writes the count

step1.camera: Macro tracking shot inside a realistic matte-white brain cross-section in a bright white studio gallery
step1.action: a smooth, steady bioluminescent green light pulse glides cleanly inside the white-matter fiber tracts from the inner ear along white-matter nerve fibers into the auditory cortex on the side of the brain
step1.prop_change: The auditory cortex ignites electric cyan-blue as rhythmic waves of bioluminescent green light pulse across its folded surface in time with the ticking sound
step1.reaction: Surrounding matte-white cortical folds catch crisp daylight rim lighting while the glowing electric cyan-blue region brightens with each pulse

step2.camera: Smooth orbiting macro shot inside the realistic matte-white brain in bright studio daylight, pushing in from the side of the brain to the base
step2.action: A bright bridge of warm amber-gold white-matter fibers locks in between the electric cyan-blue auditory cortex and the brainstem at the base of the brain
step2.prop_change: Bioluminescent green internal fiber light pulse race across the warm amber-gold pathway and ignite the brainstem in a steady golden-green glow that triggers the salivary reflex
step2.reaction: The rest of the matte-white brain rests in clean studio daylight as the new pathway pulses smoothly from top to bottom

step3.camera: Wide lateral tracking shot gliding across the thick soundproof wall of the Saint Petersburg laboratory, revealing both compartments
step3.action: In the right room, the experimenter mannequin squeezes a rubber air bulb at a control board, while in the left room the porcelain dog pricks its ears and licks its lips
step3.prop_change: The rubber bulb collapses, the metronome pendulum swings and ticks, and clear saliva drops fall from the cheek funnel into the glass tube
step3.reaction: Behind the wall, the experimenter mannequin sits bolt upright and presses his palm flat on the desk as the recorder clicks

breakthrough.camera: Medium slow push-in on the central wooden harness stand in the bright laboratory with the bearded physiologist and assistant mannequins flanking the porcelain dog
breakthrough.action: The assistant mannequin presses a wall buzzer button once before sliding the bowl, and the porcelain dog shifts forward in the leather straps and drools on cue
breakthrough.prop_change: The buzzer vibrates, clear saliva drips steadily from the glass cheek funnel, and the liquid rises in the tube mark by mark
breakthrough.reaction: The bearded physiologist mannequin lifts the graduated glass tube toward the tall window light while the assistant clenches his notebook

conclusion.camera: Slow pull-back rising to an elevated wide shot of a sunlit modern kitchen counter
conclusion.action: A matte-white porcelain person in a grey hoodie sits at the counter holding a ceramic mug, then jerks a hand forward to grab a smartphone the instant it chimes
conclusion.prop_change: The face-down smartphone screen flashes and vibrates across the counter while dark coffee splashes over the rim of the ceramic mug
conclusion.reaction: The porcelain figure freezes mid-reach with lifted shoulders and slowly pulls its hand back from the glowing phone in bright morning daylight

step1.link: Each metronome tick sends sound signals from the ears into the auditory cortex, the brain's hearing center, right before food arrives.

step2.link: Repeated pairing links the hearing center to the brainstem, the automatic reflex center whose salivary nuclei drive drooling.

anatomy_descriptors.auditory cortex: folded ridge on the side of the brain above the ear
anatomy_descriptors.brainstem: stalk-like reflex hub at the base of the brain
